raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
Allows any number of minions to be enabled for the minion roulette, instead of having to choose between the "up to 30" and "EVERYTHING" modes supported by the game.

A lot like my existing plugin BetterMountRoulette, except simpler (there's no hidden second roulette to worry about, nor are there any cast bars to finagle).
